spec.description:
ProctorWrap
HighTack Tape is a single-sided pressure-sensitive adhesive tape formulated with
an aggressive, modified acrylate adhesive and a flexible synthetic carrier.
Engineered to provide an airtight and watertight seal on vapour-permeable
construction membranes, it is widely used to seal overlaps, window flashings,
and pipe or service penetrations. It offers good ageing resistance, long-term
elasticity, and resistance to plasticiser migration to maintain building
envelope integrity.
features:
Aggressive modified acrylate adhesive with
high initial tack

Flexible synthetic carrier accommodates building movement
and thermal expansion

Forms an airtight and watertight seal on
vapour-permeable membranes

Free of solvents, chlorine, and formaldehyde for
low jobsite emissions

High ageing resistance and resistance to plasticiser
migration
Bonds to PE, PP, aluminium foils, timber, plastics, and metal
Hand-tearable or easily cut with a utility knife for fast installation
Operating temperature performance suitable for demanding Australian climates

technical.value: Forms waterproof and airtight barrier seal

spec.fire:
Complies with early fire hazard requirements to AS 1530.2 when used on
compliant building membranes
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.2:2017, Green Star
compliant, Passive House compatible
spec.sustainability:
Solvent-free, zero
chlorine, zero formaldehyde, low VOC emissions
install:
Ensure surfaces
to be taped are clean, dry, and free of dust, grease, oil, and frost

Position
membrane overlap with minimum recommended lap width

Centre the 60mm HighTack
Tape squarely over the seam or penetration edge

Apply tape smoothly avoiding
tension wrinkles and air pockets

Press down firmly along the entire tape
length using a plastic squeegee to activate the adhesive

Ensure substrate is
supported from behind while applying squeegee pressure

For pipes and ducts,
cut overlapping collar strips to form a continuous watertight collar
selection_checklist:
Confirm membrane type (compatible with PE, PP, and
polyolefin non-woven wraps)

Calculate total linear meters needed for seams,
openings, and penetrations
Verify that mechanical fasteners carry structural membrane loads
limitations:
Pressure-sensitive adhesive requires firm
mechanical squeegee pressure to bond properly

Must not be applied to wet,
oily, or dusty surfaces

Not designed for permanent outdoor UV exposure beyond
membrane limits
spec.warranty:
Backed by Proctor Group Australia product
warranty

use_cases:
Sealing horizontal and
vertical laps on vapour-permeable wall wraps

Creating airtight and watertight
seals around plumbing pipes and electrical penetrations

Taping window and
door flashing interfaces to building membranes
retrieval.rag_summary:
ProctorWrap
High Tack Tape is a flexible, single-sided pressure-sensitive adhesive tape
featuring an aggressive modified acrylate adhesive on a reinforced polyolefin
carrier. Sized at 60mm x 25m, it is engineered to form an airtight and
watertight seal across vapour-permeable wall wraps, roof underlays, window
interfaces, and pipe penetrations. Resistant to plasticiser migration,
temperature extremes from -40°C to +80°C, and building movement, it provides
durable weather protection and air-sealing compliance with AS/NZS 4200.2:2017.
